headline: 135 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Timber Fire in CA, threatening 775 structures.

active_threats.name: Timber
active_threats.narrative: The Timber Fire in Monterey County, CA has burned 25,426 acres and is 39% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **775 structures threatened**. 1,219 personnel are assigned. Winds are expected to stay comparatively light over the next 24 hours (gusts near 10 mph), which should limit further wind-driven spread for now. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. Forecast wind direction (S, blowing toward the N) favors pushing the fire toward Carmel Valley Village CDP, 20 miles away.

wind.windninja_applicability: HIGH  - core use case; downscale the sustained flow

emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over AR: Little Rock city, Jonesboro city, Benton city, Paragould city, and Jacksonville city and 12 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,4,5,6). USGS fire-danger models put the local large-fire/spread probability as high as 1% in spots. No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
